requirements.current_scope: Exact d76c351a mounted index daemon averaged 0.067% of one core over 60 seconds with 1,000 files and no clients, with a 0.20% peak over ten-second intervals. The index stayed Ready, the file count stayed at 248,638, and the snapshot advanced one revision. This is a bounded live-workload sample. Current Windows idle/lifetime verification remains open.
